question: In a certain code language, 'ASKING' is coded as 'SAIKGN'. What is the code for 'DECIDE' in that code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'ASKING' is coded as 'SAIKGN'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e1c80c9931e6fe7e95f47c54c3ef25a540f54babf94b902ccffa3c02e7cb587.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2baa6e98439048085365ac018a9c729b0580823e923a859e14132df133f04a2.png] 

Similarly,

'DECIDE' is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbe9d5bb2e8351da215aa501942d779a8b348c4cc4e54e93e2b43ce762e88f1f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ac74ca25c9d85af34d04a4f6548ca77d3c33dab0643fb5fa9d3e05031203184.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EDICED".**
